symptom: The durable route's whole-German file coordinate no longer exists after disk consolidation, while the exact P42 interval survives.
resolution_or_hold: Draft against the immutable P42 snapshot only; canon owner must return the replacement pointer and lineage receipt before checked promotion.
residual_risk: A later canon pointer may require source-version reconciliation by an independent checker; the producer must not infer identity beyond the preserved snapshot.

symptom: The retained Noether root contains preservation ZIPs between roughly 13 GB and 45 GB, and broad/recursive discovery previously destabilized the PC.
resolution_or_hold: Never recurse through the retired tree or broad parents; do not open/hash giant ZIPs; keep all corpus operations serial and exact-path bounded.
residual_risk: A future stale path may tempt broad rediscovery; public metadata must also avoid leaking the private absolute root.

symptom: The configured Korean/CJK native-source junction survives as metadata but its target path is missing, so local Korean attestations could not be read.
resolution_or_hold: Use prior Korean producer terminology only for continuity, expose every new trap-prone choice, and wait for restoration or explicit re-routing of a Korean-native corpus.
residual_risk: Terms such as maximal order, different, and historical regular ideal may be non-idiomatic or nonstandard in ko-KR; ko-KP remains entirely unsupported.

symptom: German Ordnung, Maximalordnung, and Hauptordnung form a trap cluster: a literal Sino-xenic form can collide with modern Korean 정칙환 meaning regular ring, while Hauptordnung has the ring-of-integers sense.
resolution_or_hold: Producer draft uses 오더, 극대 오더, and 정수환; an independent Korean algebra/number-theory checker must approve or replace the lexicon globally.
residual_risk: 오더 is a global loan and may be stylistically undesirable; 정수환 may overmodernize historical Hauptordnung; unchecked replacements must be global and relation-aware.

symptom: Historical Quotientenring nach p is a false friend: the source's own denominator condition defines localization, not a quotient by p.
resolution_or_hold: Draft uses p에 대한 국소화환; checker must assess Korean historical register and whether a parenthetical source term is needed.
residual_risk: A historically oriented checker may prefer a gloss preserving the old German label; no human terminology decision exists.

work_unit: P42 U04, U09, U11 historical algebra vocabulary
symptom: Historical Automorphismenring, regulär, normal, and ähnlich do not map one-to-one onto modern Korean surface forms.
resolution_or_hold: Keep provisional target forms and require a checker-owned global terminology decision; do not silently normalize isolated occurrences.
residual_risk: A checker may need coordinated replacements across definitions, theorems, and proofs; local patching could break conceptual consistency.

symptom: The first metadata-only PowerShell command failed with ParserError: An empty pipe element is not allowed.
resolution_or_hold: Use explicit collection before projection in bounded PowerShell metadata commands; all twelve target hashes and LF-normalized source-slice hashes were then recorded.
residual_risk: The successful hash table proves byte identity, not completeness, correctness, TeX validity, or review.

work_unit: P42 Hangul/Hanja and South-/North-Korean standard boundary
symptom: No locally accessible Korean-native corpus or ko-KP standards evidence was available to authorize Hanja insertions or North-Korean variants.
resolution_or_hold: Producer target remains ko-KR and Hangul-first; Hanja and ko-KP decisions await independent language evidence.
residual_risk: Some Korean mathematical readers may expect conventional Hanja or different terminology; ko-KP equivalence is entirely unknown.

symptom: The first difficulty-ledger validator run failed before reading records because PowerShell interpreted the line-number variable followed by a colon inside a double-quoted string as an invalid variable reference.
resolution_or_hold: Validator source now uses braced line-number interpolation; rerun is required and its report must not be conflated with the failed first run.
residual_risk: A successful rerun validates ledger structure only; it cannot validate translation, source, formulas, or review state.
